comments.author: CarsonDavis
comments.body: Heads-up for review: commit 1b26da41 extends item 2 — the shapefile `.prj` is now computed in the browser in **every** mode, not just static builds. LayersTool and DrawTool call `projStringToWkt` directly; the server's `/api/utils/proj42wkt` Python route loses its last first-party caller (kept in full for API compat, gated in lean by #133 — see the review thread there). This is the series' first deliberate full-mode behavior change, senior-dev approved 2026-06-11; the PR body's item 2 carries the details. Verified: both build personalities compile; `projStringToWkt` (11) and dispatcher parity (3) suites pass.
